sw_description: Katarn kit, a quick tree-climbing predator of Kashyyyk's canopy. Starter.
Young katarn, leaf-bladed arms, lightning fast in the canopy.
Adult katarn, the apex hunter of the wroshyr forests.
Desert fowl chick that stores the heat of the twin suns. Starter.
Long-legged sunfowl that kicks with burning talons.
Towering sunfowl wreathed in flame, the fighter of the Dune Sea.
Swamp amphibian hatchling with a fin that senses currents. Starter.
Mud-coated amphibian, strong legs for land and lake.
Hulking swamp amphibian that can tow a bongo through the core.
Scrap-hunting scurrier that zigzags around picking things up (Pickup).
Grown scurrier that rushes straight at anything shiny.
Seed-shaped sprite that hangs from Endor's branches.
Tricky forest imp with a leaf whistle.
Forest spirit whose leaf fans whip up gales.
Small Force-sensitive swamp sprite that feels emotions. Luke's first creature.
Force sprite that dances when its trainer is happy.
Force sprite that will shield its trainer at any cost.
Fungus-armored jungle brawler with spring-loaded arms.
Swamp sloth that sleeps 20 hours a day (Truant).
Restless swamp sloth that cannot sit still.
Enormous, lazy, terrifyingly strong swamp sloth.
Dathomir fox kit that vanishes in a puff of green mist (Teleport).
Mist fox that bends spoons and minds.
Ancient mist fox of terrible mental power.
Wingless hive grub that lives underground.
Winged hive insect, incredibly fast.
Stocky cub that slaps trees to toughen up.
Massive forest brawler whose palm strikes fell trees.
Ice-cave lemur that meditates to stay calm.
Lemur whose meditation gives it Force-sharpened strikes.
Round puff that sings in its sleep.
Balloon creature whose song puts crowds to sleep.
Balloon diva whose fur is the softest on Tatooine.
Mole that pops out of Cloud City's tibanna mine floors.
Three burrownubs working as one.
Kamino training droid; reconfigures into a kicking, punching or spinning model.
Training droid with extending legs, kicking specialist.
Training droid with heavy fists, punching specialist.
Training droid that spins on its head like a top.
Narglatch cub of the frozen moon.
Ice-world narglatch whose eerie call bewitches foes.
Lava sprite with a live coal for a heart.
Lava sprite that spits molten rock.
Shapeshifting blob that copies any creature (Transform).
Huge, lazy happabore, asleep where it stands.
Guardian of Mortis's seas that keeps the balance (psychic/flying).
Guardian of Mortis's skies whose feathers shine with light (fire/flying).
Star-born creature of Atollon that shifts between many forms.
